10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:ba0e9583-cea0-46.title: Digital Transformation Manager - AI Trainer - Freelance - 8-20 hrs/week - Remote
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:ba0e9583-cea0-46.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced digital transformation manager who instinctively spots gaps in operational reasoning and understands the complex realities of driving digital change? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies digital transformation expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable digital transformation managers based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered operational and transformation systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to digital transformation, organizational change, technology adoption, and practical aspects of transformation processes - Evaluate AI responses for operational accuracy, practicality, and compliance with real-world requirements - Draft realistic digital transformation scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. transformation manager, client, stakeholder, or vendor) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated transformation content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects true digital transformation reasoning, authentic operational procedures, and practical management approaches. Rather than conducting traditional transformation work, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about digital change at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level digital transformation manager with significant professional experience within the EU or UK - Experienced in advising on, planning, and executing digital transformation strategies and projects - Skilled at evaluating operational processes, requirements, and compliance - Comfortable working independently and providing structured, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with prompt availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your current commitments - Apply your digital transformation expertise in a rapidly evolving, high-impact AI environment - Directly contribute to building advanced AI operational and transformation systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further develop your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured tasks, and ongoing opportunities for collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the digital transformation expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. apcoholdings-apcoholdings:lever:8923b948.description: APCO Holdings partners with dealerships across North America to deliver innovative vehicle protection products and services that enhance the ownership experience for customers and drive growth for our partners. Through our family of brands, we bring together industry expertise, technology, and data-driven insights to help dealers strengthen their finance and insurance performance and build lasting relationships with their customers. Our teams work collaboratively across operations, technology, risk, finance, marketing, and sales to deliver solutions that create measurable value and support the continued growth of APCO and the partners we serve. We are looking for a Dealer Performance Manager to support and grow a portfolio of dealership partners. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to your accounts using a consultative approach to strengthen relationships, optimize performance, and drive long-term retention and revenue growth.
responsibilities: Manage and grow relationships with existing dealership partners within your assigned territory
Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive retention and revenue growth
Analyze dealership performance data to identify opportunities and recommend solutions
Present APCO/GWC products and value proposition to align with dealer needs
Negotiate renewals and contract terms to retain and expand business
Build relationships with key decision-makers across dealership leadership teams
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a high level of service and partner satisfaction
Travel regularly within your region to meet with dealership partners
qualifications: 5+ years of automotive industry outside sales experience
Proven experience in consultative, relationship-based sales or account management
Strong understanding of dealership operations and F&I products
Valid driver’s license with ability to travel extensively (up to 75%)
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
Experience in F&I management, dealership leadership, or performance consulting
Knowledge of reinsurance, retro programs, and back-end dealership operations
Experience analyzing business performance data and developing strategic plans

assistworld-assist-world:lever:37b6a0bd-.title: Virtual Executive Assistant — Real Estate & Property Operations
assistworld-assist-world:lever:37b6a0bd-.description: The client real estate and construction business with a rental portfolio of roughly 50 properties, managed through a mix of about seven external property managers and some units he oversees directly. He also has active new-construction projects, is acquiring a franchise (101 Mobility — mobility ramps and lifts), and is setting up a recording studio. This is his first time hiring support, and he needs someone to take ownership of recurring admin and communications so he can focus on the business. Key Responsibilities • Track mortgage payments across the rental property portfolio and follow up to keep everything current. • Monitor rent payments for self-managed tenants; flag late or missing payments and escalate appropriately (e.g., routing to eviction process when needed). • Keep organized records (currently Google Sheets) across ~7 property managers and ~50 rental units. • Manage Rob's email inbox — organize, label, and respond on his behalf where appropriate. • Manage his calendar and scheduling. • Make and take phone calls with vendors, utility providers, and servicers — e.g., setting up/tearing down utilities between tenants on construction turnovers. • Provide general executive assistant support across Rob's ventures (construction, property management, franchise acquisition, recording studio) — the day-to-day mix will be varied and ad hoc. • Help coordinate documentation and next steps with outside professionals (e.g., tax structuring) — not performing the work itself, but keeping it moving. • Help build out a simple, reliable tracking system for tenant and mortgage payments, with an eye toward adopting dedicated software down the line. What We're Looking For • Prior experience as a VA or EA, ideally with exposure to real estate, property management, or small business operations. • Comfortable making and taking phone calls with vendors and service providers. • Highly organized and able to manage multiple, sometimes competing priorities for one busy principal. • Proficient in Google Workspace (Sheets, Gmail, Calendar). • Discreet and dependable — this role touches sensitive financial information (rent, mortgages, credit-related matters). • Comfortable with ambiguity — the role is still taking shape and will evolve as the working relationship develops. • Able to work Eastern Time hours.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ffa33533-fab2-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ffa33533-fab2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Sweden. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships. Pro
